verdict.rationale: Proa ships its own state primitives, so no third-party library is implied. Islands can declare signals and event handlers (proa-gh-3), each hydrated island gets seed state (proa-docs-16), and renders get typed access to request-scoped data and route state through WebContext (proa-docs-18). None of this shows application-wide state shared across islands or pages; the evidence only shows per-island and per-request scope. Missing for 10: documented global/shared store or cross-island signal sharing, state persistence across navigation, API docs for state management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
